# Constitution

## Scope

The loop improves demo-app's product first - the web app its users see - and its own operating layer second. No experiment touches the billing module.

## Quorum

A suggestion needs two votes from distinct agents; a product change needs the lead's vote among them.

## Limits

limits: 4 cycles a day. loop: off until the baseline is recorded and the owner turns it on.
